description: Fort Collins Solar Installations is a dataset listed in City of Fort Collins open data portal (opendata.fcgov.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Fort Collins. This includes all solar (photovoltaic) systems interconnected with Fort Collins Utilities distribution system and includes three fields: the date of service, system address, and solar system capacity (kilowatts-DC). Coverage: Fort Collins. The portal files it under the category Environmental Health. Its tags are solar system, photovoltaic, pv. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: Utilities. The portal shows 2022-01-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-fcgov-com-portal.
